notes": "Lite review batch 0519 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/talents/cursed/cursed-form.lua",
      "source": "You rise to meet the pain that others would inflict on you. Every turn you take damage, your Strength and Willpower increase until they reach a maximum of +%d after 5 turns. Any turn in which you do not take damage will reduce the bonus. While in effect, your body also has a %d%% chance to overcome poisons and diseases each turn.",
      "source_tag": "tformat",
      "special": null,
      "target": "你勇于面对其他人带给你的痛苦。每回合当你承受伤害时，你将会增加你的力量和意志，直至在 5 回合后增加至最大值 +%d。\n\t\t每个你不承受伤害的回合会降低该增益效果。\n\t\t当此效果激活时，每回合你有 %d%% 的几率清除身上的毒素和疾病效果。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "8d6d4ae374dc7dc10900efd2db22b1bf29f03454b4b8fb214291557b7f2c43c0",
      "notes": "Lite review batch 0519 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/talents/misc/inscriptions.lua",
      "source": "Activate the taint to purge your body of physical afflictions for %d turns.\n\t\t\tEach turn the purge will attempt to cleanse 1 physical debuff from you, and if one is removed, increase its duration by 1.",
      "source_tag": "tformat",
      "special": null,
      "target": "激活这个印记，清除你身上的物理负面效果，持续 %d 回合。\n\t\t\t每一回合，净化效果将会尝试从你的身上解除一个物理负面效果。\n\t\t\t如果成功解除了一个负面效果，净化效果的持续时间会增加 1 回合。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "87edcb97886f16f8867f997dc17d399c86aaf591b4a10529d39c3483a551ce91",
      "notes": "Lite review batch 0519 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/talents/spells/dreadmaster.lua",
      "source": "You now summon a Dreadmaster instead of a Dread.\n\t\tDreadmasters learn to cast silence, disperse magic and mind disruption, making them the ultimate annoyance tool.\n\t\tIt learns them at talent level %d.",
      "source_tag": "tformat",
      "special": null,
      "target": "你现在改为召唤噩灵之王，而不是噩灵。\n\t\t噩灵之王可以释放技能等级 %d 的沉默、驱散和精神干扰，是扰乱敌人的强大力量。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "d83ff864b20e9aba598396e4f0bdfbacaa2732fae245ea1ff87a13ea47a85791",
      "notes": "Lite review batch 0519 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/talents/cunning/scoundrel.lua",
      "source": "Your abilities in sowing confusion and chaos have reached their peak.  Whenever a foe attempts to apply a detrimental physical effect to you, they have a %d%% chance to fail. If there is an adjacent enemy to you, you misdirect your foe into applying it to them at %d%% duration.\nYou gain %d defense.\nThe chance to apply status effects increases with your Accuracy and the Defense with your Cunning.",
      "source_tag": "tformat",
      "special": null,
      "target": "你制造混乱的技巧已趋于巅峰。\n\t\t敌人试图对你施加物理负面状态时，有 %d%% 几率失败。成功使其失败时，如果相邻格有敌人，这一效果将会被转移到这个敌人身上，持续时间变为 %d%%。\n\t\t你获得 %d 闪避。\n\t\t施加负面状态几率受命中影响。\n\t\t闪避加成受灵巧影响。"
    }
  ],
